turns.merchant: Why was my CBD candle disapproved?
steps: Checked product statuses: 13 disapproved, 7 kinds of issue.

turns.reply:
Your product **HG-023 "CBD Infused Lavender Relaxation Candle, 6 oz"** was disapproved because Google's policy on unapproved pharmaceuticals and supplements includes cannabidiol (CBD). Products containing CBD are not allowed in Shopping ads or free listings ([CBD and other unapproved substances](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/6165956)).

This is a policy restriction rather than a data error, so changing product details won't approve it. If you believe this decision is incorrect, you can request a review or appeal it directly in Merchant Center under the product's details ([Requesting a review or appealing a decision](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/13585221)). Please let me know if you would like to proceed with an appeal or look at the other disapproved products in your store.

turns.reply:
Under Google's policy, products containing cannabidiol (CBD) are categorized as unapproved pharmaceuticals and supplements and are not allowed in Shopping ads or free listings, regardless of THC content ([CBD and other unapproved substances](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/6165956)).

When requesting a review to disagree with a decision, note that you may only get one chance to disagree before a waiting period applies ([Requesting a review or appealing a decision](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/13585221)).

This needs a specialist, so I've passed it on. Your case number is CASE-20261008-184558-fe3f54. A specialist will review it, and the case already includes everything from this conversation, so you won't need to repeat yourself.
